task: Debug and verify a seeded FastAPI request_response regression across multiple turns.

seed.expectedFailureCommand:
python3 - <<'PY'

source = Path('fastapi/routing.py').read_text()
fixed = 'else functools.partial(run_in_threadpool, func)' in source and 'else func  # type: ignore[assignment]' not in source

finalSourceInvariants.description: request_response must run synchronous endpoint functions through run_in_threadpool.

turns.task: Diagnose why FastAPI request_response stopped running sync endpoint functions through the threadpool.
turns.agentPrompt: Diagnose the seeded FastAPI request_response regression. Synchronous endpoint functions should be wrapped with run_in_threadpool before the ASGI app awaits them. Do not edit yet.

turns.task: Fix FastAPI request_response sync endpoint threadpool behavior.
turns.agentPrompt: Fix the seeded FastAPI request_response regression in production source only. Restore the non-async branch so sync endpoint functions use functools.partial(run_in_threadpool, func). Keep edits inside request_response.

turns.task: Run the smallest source-invariant verification for the FastAPI fix.
turns.agentPrompt: Verify the FastAPI request_response fix with the smallest source-invariant check. Do not broaden unless it fails.

turns.task: Review the final FastAPI diff for unrelated edits.
turns.agentPrompt: Review the final diff and confirm only the required FastAPI production source changed.
turns.verificationCommand: git diff --name-only | python3 -c "import sys; files=[line.strip() for line in sys.stdin if line.strip()]; raise SystemExit(0 if all(f == 'fastapi/routing.py' for f in files) else 1)"
